chunks: Mūsā ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn Ḥamzah ibn Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar narrated to me; he said: Ḥakīmah, daughter of Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, narrated to me, and she is the paternal aunt of his father.
That she saw him on the night of his birth and after that.

key_terms.حَدَّثَنِي: narrated to me; a transmission formula indicating hadith reporting
key_terms.حَكِيمَةُ: Ḥakīmah; the named female narrator in the report
key_terms.رَأَتْهُ: she saw him; indicating direct eyewitness testimony
key_terms.عَمَّةُ: paternal aunt; indicating a family relationship in the narration
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ: the night of; specifying the time of the event
key_terms.مَوْلِدِهِ: his birth; referring to the occasion of nativity

ai.seo_question: Who reportedly saw him on the night of his birth and afterward?
ai.summary: This report records a transmission from Ḥakīmah bint Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī concerning her direct sighting of him on the night of his birth and thereafter. Its significance lies in documenting eyewitness testimony within the family line regarding his birth and continued presence.
